reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not a human expert

points.observation: E-commerce case describes paid funnel/landing-page changes with a POAS change from 2 to 5x and a 90-day timeframe.
SaaS case lists MAU growth, CAC reduction and activation improvement as separate metrics; exact denominators are not supplied by a creative screenshot.
Creative gallery demonstrates different landing pages/ads; its proximity does not identify all clients or connect it to every aggregate outcome.

cautions: POAS, ROAS and ROI are different names; preserve the PDF's wording even if inconsistent.
Page 4 aggregate achievements must not be silently assigned to the individual page 5 or 6 campaigns.
Long gallery page has small details; do not invent tiny text or infer A/B testing just from variants.
All-page visual contact-sheet review with text-layer aid where available. Independent source notes by Codex, not human expert or real-world truth verification.
